title: LayerDrop surviving-layer Mirror roles
hypothesis: Depth-specific Mirror roles on surviving residual blocks recover shallow LayerDrop functions with fewer bytes than independent shallow models and better storage than ordinary gates.
mirror_coordinate: depth-config-specific scalar role on each surviving block

development.selection_metric: output nMSE, actual bytes, MAC proxy

fresh.reason: Direct gate is exact specificity control.

success_gate: Depth-2/3 nMSE <=1e-3, >=20% fewer bytes than independent shallow models and >=10% fewer than direct gates.
failure_gate: Direct gates match Mirror or shallow quality gate fails.
boundaries: no LayerDrop pretraining or LM claim
fresh sealed if specificity gate fails
